function.name: add_todo
function.description: Adds a new todo item to the todo.csv file with auto-generated ID, timestamp, and pending status.

todo_text.description: The text content of the todo item to be added.

function.name: complete_todo
function.description: Marks a specific todo item as completed by its ID.

todo_id.description: The ID of the todo item to be marked as completed.

path.description: The file path to the todo.csv file. If not provided, the default path will be used.

function.name: delete_todo
function.description: Removes a specific todo item from the todo.csv file by its ID. Returns True if deletion was successful. Raises ValueError if ID not found or invalid, FileNotFoundError if file missing.

todo_id.description: The ID of the todo item to be deleted.

path.description: The path to the todo.csv file. If not provided, defaults to the file_path or 'todo.csv'.

function.name: list_todos
function.description: Returns all todo items from the todo.csv file. Parses the file robustly: IDs as strings, raises FileNotFoundError if missing,  raises exception containing 'malformed' for invalid CSV structure, and ensures no None entries are returned.

path.description: The path to the todo.csv file. If not provided, looks for 'todo.csv' in the current directory.
